snippet.title: Bones and Coins - Incremental Auto Battler - Gameplay Trailer (Steam)
snippet.description:
An incremental auto battler dungeon crawler where you build a synergized hero party to slay enemies and loot items. Unlock weapons with unique attack styles. Gear up your hero team and explore new dungeon rooms filled with enemies and legendary drops.

Wishlist it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4134650/Bones_and_Coins/
